text:
Type: woven stripe throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, coastal, bohemian
Materials: woven cotton with textured dobby stripes
Colors: cream, navy, grey
Shape: square, vertical stripes of herringbone and diamond motifs, knife edges, medium size
Feel: relaxed, calm, crafted
Goes with: white or navy sofas, natural wood, jute; farmhouse or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Global Stripe Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Navy
product.description: Made in USA and imported Yarn-dyed stripe has unique diamond and herringbone patterns for a tasteful update to a classic look. Back of pillow is textured, navy-colored fabric. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. 17"L x 17"W Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove pillow from packaging and let it fully expand.
